_comment: Operator-declared proxy rate. The Hive vendor does not publish a per-token list price this repository can cite, so the operator directed these runs be priced at the OpenAI gpt-4o catalog rate. This is a proxy for cost accounting, NOT a Hive list price: never cite it as the vendor's rate, and never promote it into defaultPricingCatalog() (see docs/harness-pricing-coverage.md §1). Using gpt-4o keeps the approved collection proposal's arithmetic valid (proposal §5).
source: operator-declared proxy: openai/gpt-4o catalog rate (defaultPricingCatalog), not a Hive-published rate
